annotations.text:
All three directions now live in the dashboard itself — switch with
Archive / Console / Pressroom in the top bar.

ARCHIVE  warm paper · Newsreader + Archivo · hairline rules · 3px corners
CONSOLE  near-black telemetry · IBM Plex Mono throughout · acid signal · square
PRESSROOM  bone + black · Anton display · 2px rules · one red accent

The rail navigates six views. Start/Stop, the account switcher, every toggle,
the series rows and the cookie sheet all work. Real data throughout: level 69,
1,240 ink, 11,220 pulls, 1,831 cards recycled for 114,120 ink.

Phone view, same three themes.
Artboards share no state, so this one switches on its own.
No fake status bar — the real one draws on top.
